findings.title: Trace hash integrity is checked but full batch transition/identity validation is absent
findings.evidence: Reader.chain checks seq/previous/hash/schema. run checks first/last event, failures, two begin/end/cache_commit records, and Euler counts. It does not implement per-batch unique-ID, nonoverlap, sample/sampler/cache/map state transitions or reject internal duplicate session/end events. Archive metadata.batch_id is available but discarded for correspondence selection.
findings.impact: Cannot claim the protocol's two-chain semantic ordering and closure from these checks alone. A coherently sealed malformed transition sequence is not rejected by the missing gates; this is static reasoning, not an executed mutation test.
findings.requested_change: Implement a small separate read-only trace state machine for two complete unique batches, denoiser callback order/count and single-session closure; connect each relevant archive capture metadata.batch_id to the same trace batch instead of only occurrence position. Existing src/s20_generation_trace.py385-490 supplies the known transition semantics; do not run/import its legacy verify_trace whole-payload reader.

findings.title: Saved operation outputs are not fully connected to the claimed actual CLIP/sample/target chain
findings.evidence: actual_clip_to_cache compares cache_commit.target_encoder_embeddings with committed rows; it never compares encode_image_output with that variable or saved target sample rows with encode_image_input. sampler_output.output is not compared with sample_output.samples_z. Target cameras/K are compared with cache but only context camera/K prefixes are checked at translation/get_cond entry.
findings.impact: Current successful comparisons establish commit-variable→cache→selected-context→condition/sampler-input. They do not independently establish all already-saved upstream operation-result bridges stated in the intended full chain.
findings.requested_change: Use each capture's actual metadata.batch_id and causal interval to pair target encode_image_input/output (without assuming a universal fixed encoding count); compare all target samples to encoder input, encoder result to committed all-target embeddings, sampler output to samples_z, batch target camera/K suffixes to actual translation/get_cond inputs, and translation scaling output to get_cond scalar. Do not recompute CLIP, VAE, sampler, camera math or pixel conversion.

passes_with_static_scope: Manifest/external receipt SHA anchors and declared ft-mse identity kept separate from exact original baseline
Archive actual physical inventory, per-file size/hash, tensor body+descriptor hash and sidecars are dynamically verified
Archive capture pairing/order and full raw tensor presence checked; saved trace blobs hashed; missing trace payloads labelled metadata only
Actual selected cache values checked against context stacks, first committed5 against next context cache, actual get_cond output against sampler inputs, selected latent channels against cond.replace
FP64→FP32 limited to small camera/K inputs and explicitly labelled before exact bitwise comparison; other comparisons require same dtype/bits
NumPy1.26.4 loaded late; comparisons use read-only memmap and chunked bitwise equality, without Torch/codec/renderer/model imports
No real data/results are created by import; new output directory required; failures and narrow success scope distinguished

resource_boundary.CPU1: Suggested environment only; script does not enforce or verify actual thread limit
resource_boundary.RSS2GiB: Not enforced by this script; mandatory external supervisor before execution
resource_boundary.300_seconds: Fixed argument and cooperative tick checks; no preemptive timer around JSON loading/other blocking operations. External supervisor must enforce whole-tree deadline.
resource_boundary.low_memory: Large tensor payloads use memmap; JSON/event chains are materialized in RAM, so peak RSS cannot be certified statically
